# KylixAI

> Kylix understands the business before it builds the AI. It studies how work actually happens, finds where time, money and opportunities are being lost, and builds the right system with software, AI and human judgment where each belongs.

## Position

Business understanding is Kylix's primary advantage. Process engineering follows. AI-native execution is a means of building the appropriate system. Business first. Process second. Technology third.

## Services

- [Services: Diagnose, Build & Operate](https://kylixai.com/services): The commercial path from a free fit call through diagnosis, implementation and ongoing systems management.
- [Systems Opportunity Audit](https://kylixai.com/systems-opportunity-audit): A $199 launch-price business and process diagnostic that delivers a Kylix Systems Roadmap. The full fee is credited toward implementation; it is refunded if no meaningful opportunity is identified; clients keep the roadmap either way.
- [Build & Implementation](https://kylixai.com/build-and-implementation): Business systems design, implementation, integration, testing, deployment and documentation. Starting around $2,500; actual pricing depends on scope.
- [Systems Management](https://kylixai.com/systems-management): Ongoing operation and improvement of deployed business infrastructure. Starting around $500/month; responsibilities are scoped together.
